title: File
description: One TRIP in the Agloe format. Terms in capitals are defined in spec/vocabulary.md. spec/rules.md says what each part means.

id.description: Assigned once and never changed. Unique across the whole FILE.

name.description: Text for people to read. It holds no control character and no line or paragraph separator, and at least one character that is not a space. The pattern lists those characters one by one, so that every regular expression engine agrees. A reader also refuses half of a surrogate pair, which a pattern cannot state for every engine.

time.description: A date and time to the second, with its offset from UTC and the name of its time zone in brackets. This is a narrow form of RFC 9557. The offset must be the one that time zone has at that moment, by the release of the time-zone database that Agloe pins. The time lies in the years 0001 to 9999, on its own clock and in UTC.

length.description: A length of time in hours, minutes and seconds (ISO 8601), such as PT2H30M.

currency.description: The name of a currency: USD, AA-points. Amounts in different currencies are never added or compared.

amount.description: An amount of money: a decimal number written as text. Digits, and at most four more after a point. It has no sign, no exponent and no separator.

payment.title: Payment
payment.description: What a BOOKING paid: its whole price, with nothing left to pay. It can name the BUDGET the money came from and the PERSON who paid.

budget.title: Budget
budget.description: A BUDGET: a named source of money. It can pay for a place that one of its PERSONs takes, or that covers one of its OBJECTs, at a price in a currency it holds.

persons.description: The PERSONs who may draw on the BUDGET for what the TRIP still has to buy.

objects.description: The OBJECTs whose places the BUDGET may pay for. Left out: none.

currencies.description: The currencies the BUDGET holds: one or more.

capability.title: Capability
capability.description: A CAPABILITY: something a PERSON can do, such as driving a manual car or swimming.

object.title: Object
object.description: An OBJECT: a physical thing that OPTIONs may require, hand over or keep, such as a bag, a passport or a key.

option_at_a_place.title: OptionAtAPlace
option_at_a_place.description: An OPTION that happens at one PLACE.

option_between_places.title: OptionBetweenPlaces
option_between_places.description: An OPTION that moves from one PLACE to another.

way_one_way.title: WayOneWay
way_one_way.description: A WAY from one PLACE to another. A PERSON can take it at any time, and as often as they need.

way_both_ways.title: WayBothWays
way_both_ways.description: A WAY between two PLACEs, in both directions. A PERSON can take it at any time, and as often as they need.

want.title: Want
want.description: A WANT: something PERSONs want, or want to avoid, from the TRIP. It is about something an OPTION can deliver, or, with `itinerary`, about the whole ITINERARY. Each holder is a PERSON with their own DEGREE OF WANT, and a WANT names each PERSON at most once. A WANT about the whole ITINERARY is a must for each holder.

itinerary.title: Ending
itinerary.description: What the WANT asks of the whole ITINERARY. `ends_at`: the holder ends the TRIP at this PLACE.

degree.description: The DEGREE OF WANT. 10 makes the WANT a must for this PERSON, and -10 makes it a must-not.

fixed_start.title: FixedStart
fixed_start.description: A FACT: the OPTION can start only at this time.

free_start.title: FreeStart
free_start.description: A FACT: the planners choose when the OPTION starts.

exact_duration.title: ExactDuration
exact_duration.description: A FACT: the OPTION takes exactly this long.

contingent_duration.title: ContingentDuration
contingent_duration.description: A FACT: the world decides how long the OPTION takes, within this range.

way_duration.title: WayDuration
way_duration.description: A FACT: the WAY takes exactly this long, each time a PERSON takes it.

way_contingent_duration.title: WayContingentDuration
way_contingent_duration.description: A FACT: each time a PERSON takes the WAY, the world decides how long it takes, within this range.

access_cutoff.title: AccessCutoff
access_cutoff.description: A FACT: each PERSON must reach the OPTION's PLACE at least this long before it starts.

complete_set.title: CompleteSet
complete_set.description: A FACT: the FILE lists every OPTION and WAY that goes straight from one PLACE to another and starts within the stated span. Without `from` the FACT covers every PLACE of departure, and without `to` every PLACE of arrival.

satisfies.title: Satisfies
satisfies.description: A FACT: how fully the OPTION delivers what a WANT describes.

degree.description: The DEGREE OF SATISFACTION. Zero says that the OPTION does not deliver it. Any value above zero says that it does.

complete_for_a_want.title: CompleteForAWant
complete_for_a_want.description: A FACT: the FILE states every OPTION that SATISFIES the WANT. Each one is listed, with a FACT that it SATISFIES the WANT. So an OPTION with no such FACT does not SATISFY it, and no OPTION outside the FILE does.

needs_right.title: NeedsRight
needs_right.description: A FACT: whether a PERSON needs a right, such as a ticket or a reservation, to take part in the OPTION.

booking.title: BookingFact
booking.description: A FACT: a BOOKING. One agreement about one OPTION, for one unit that can be used at most once. It secures a right to the OPTION for each PERSON it covers.

covers.description: The PERSONs the BOOKING secures the right for, and the OBJECTs it covers.

cancelling.description: What cancelling the BOOKING costs: terms in the order of time. Each term holds from its time until the time of the next.

changing.description: What the seller charges for a change to the BOOKING: terms in the order of time. Each term holds from its time until the time of the next.

term_for_cancelling.title: TermForCancelling
term_for_cancelling.description: What cancelling a BOOKING costs from one time on. Without `from`, the term holds from when the BOOKING was made: only the first term leaves it out. A term states a cost, or that the seller accepts no cancellation while it holds, and never both. With neither, nobody has said what cancelling costs while the term holds. A term states something: a time, a cost, or that the seller accepts none.

accepted.description: Stated as false: the seller accepts no cancellation while the term holds. The BOOKING stays as it is.

costs.description: What the holder loses by cancelling: one amount for each currency, all of them together. An amount of zero is nothing.

term_for_changing.title: TermForChanging
term_for_changing.description: What the seller charges for a change to a BOOKING from one time on. Without `from`, the term holds from when the BOOKING was made: only the first term leaves it out. A term states a cost, or that the seller accepts no change while it holds, and never both. With neither, nobody has said what the seller charges while the term holds. A term states something: a time, a cost, or that the seller accepts none.

accepted.description: Stated as false: the seller accepts no change of any kind while the term holds. The BOOKING stays as it is.

costs.description: The fee for making a change: one amount for each currency, all of them together. An amount of zero is nothing. What the changed BOOKING costs more or less is no part of it.

offer.title: OfferFact
offer.description: A FACT: an OFFER. Rights to one OPTION can still be bought. Each place is one right for one PERSON, and anybody on the TRIP can take it. An OFFER that names OBJECTs is for them instead: each place is one right that covers any one of those OBJECTs.

places.description: How many rights can still be bought.

for_objects.description: The OBJECTs the places are for: one or more. Left out: the places are for PERSONs.

prices.description: What one place costs. The list has one price.

expires.description: When the OFFER expires: its places can be bought before this time, and no longer at it. Left out: nobody has said when it expires.

complete_rights.title: CompleteRights
complete_rights.description: A FACT: the rights to the OPTION for the PERSONs are COMPLETE. The BOOKINGs in the FILE secure every right for a PERSON to take part in it that anybody on the TRIP holds. Nobody on the TRIP can get another, except by a place of an OFFER that this FACT names. The FACT says nothing of a right for an OBJECT.

offers.description: The OFFERs for PERSONs to take part in the OPTION that are still open. The FILE holds no other such OFFER for it.

starts_from.title: StartsFrom
starts_from.description: A FACT: where a PERSON starts from. The PERSON's path begins at this PLACE.

has_capability.title: HasCapability
has_capability.description: A FACT: whether a PERSON has a CAPABILITY.

has.description: True: the PERSON can do it. False: the PERSON cannot.

requires_capability.title: RequiresCapability
requires_capability.description: A FACT: whether an OPTION requires a CAPABILITY, and of whom.

of.description: `one`: a PERSON who takes part in the OPTION has the CAPABILITY. `each`: every PERSON who takes part has it. `none`: the OPTION does not require it.

complete_for_a_capability.title: CompleteForACapability
complete_for_a_capability.description: A FACT: the FILE states every one of its OPTIONs that requires the CAPABILITY. Each has a FACT that it does. So an OPTION of the FILE with no FACT about the CAPABILITY does not require it.

object_starts_with.title: ObjectStartsWith
object_starts_with.description: A FACT: where an OBJECT is when the TRIP starts. A PERSON has it.

object_starts_at.title: ObjectStartsAt
object_starts_at.description: A FACT: where an OBJECT is when the TRIP starts. It lies at a PLACE.

requires_object.title: RequiresObject
requires_object.description: A FACT: whether an OPTION requires an OBJECT.

needed.description: True: the OPTION can happen only if the OBJECT is at hand just before it starts. It lies at the PLACE where the OPTION starts, or a PERSON who takes part has it. False: the OPTION does not require it.

refuses_object.title: RefusesObject
refuses_object.description: A FACT: whether an OPTION refuses an OBJECT.

refused.description: True: no PERSON has the OBJECT while they take part in the OPTION. Nobody who takes part has it just before the OPTION starts, and it is not handed over in the OPTION. False: the OPTION does not refuse it.

needs_right_for_object.title: NeedsRightForObject
needs_right_for_object.description: A FACT: whether an OPTION needs a right for an OBJECT.

needed.description: True: a right that covers the OBJECT is needed if a PERSON who takes part has it just before the OPTION starts, if it is handed over in the OPTION, or if it is carried in the OPTION. False: the OPTION needs no right for it.

complete_rights_for_an_object.title: CompleteRightsForAnObject
complete_rights_for_an_object.description: A FACT: the rights to the OPTION for one OBJECT are COMPLETE. The BOOKINGs in the FILE that cover the OBJECT secure every right to the OPTION that covers it. Nobody on the TRIP can get another, except by a place of an OFFER that this FACT names. The FACT says nothing of a right for a PERSON, or for another OBJECT.

offers.description: The OFFERs for the OPTION that name the OBJECT. The FILE holds no other such OFFER.

time_now.title: TimeNow
time_now.description: A FACT: the time now. A report treats this time as now, and says so. A FILE states it at most once. The COMPILER reads no clock.

complete_rights_needed_for_an_object.title: CompleteRightsNeededForAnObject
complete_rights_needed_for_an_object.description: A FACT: the FILE states every one of its OPTIONs that needs a right for the OBJECT. Each has a FACT that it does. So an OPTION of the FILE with no FACT about that needs no right for the OBJECT.

with_object.title: WithObject
with_object.description: A FACT: what an OPTION does with an OBJECT.

does.description: `hands_over`: where the OBJECT is at hand, a PERSON who takes part can have it from the start of the OPTION. `keeps`: where a PERSON who takes part has the OBJECT, it lies at the PLACE where the OPTION starts from then on. `carries`: where the OBJECT is at hand, it can be carried in the OPTION. Then it is in the OPTION from its start, and lies at the PLACE where the OPTION ends from its end. `nothing`: the OPTION leaves the OBJECT alone.

complete_for_an_object.title: CompleteForAnObject
complete_for_an_object.description: A FACT: the FILE states every one of its OPTIONs that requires the OBJECT or refuses it. Each has a FACT that it does. So an OPTION of the FILE with no FACT that it requires the OBJECT does not require it, and one with no FACT that it refuses the OBJECT does not refuse it.

complete_transfers.title: CompleteTransfers
complete_transfers.description: A FACT: the FILE states every OPTION that hands the OBJECT over, keeps it or carries it. Each is in the FILE, with a FACT that says so. So an OPTION of the FILE with no FACT about that leaves the OBJECT alone, and nothing outside the FILE transfers it.

trip_start.title: TripStart
trip_start.description: A DECISION: when the TRIP starts. Nothing in an ITINERARY starts before this time.

trip_end.title: TripEnd
trip_end.description: A DECISION: when the TRIP ends. Nothing in an ITINERARY ends after this time.

cap.title: Cap
cap.description: A DECISION: a cap on what the TRIP spends from one BUDGET in one currency, with what is already paid.

lock.title: Lock
lock.description: A LOCK: the TRIP includes this OPTION, and these PERSONs take part.
